parts.latex:
Complete the table below to show the immediate prerequisite(s) for activities $E$, $F$ and $G$.

\extable{825_q37_t1}
List the activities which make up the critical path for this project and state the minimum completion time.

The team are considering adding an additional activity ($X$) to the project.

It would have a completion time of 2 hours, the earliest start time of 8 hours and a latest start time of 9 hours.

Add a directed edge to show activity $X$ the diagram above.

solutions.latex:
Each activity can start only when the activities ending at its start node are finished.

Activity $E$ starts at the node where $B$ ends, so its prerequisite is $B$.

Activities $F$ and $G$ both start at the node where $C$ and $D$ end, so their prerequisites are $C$ and $D$.

$$\begin{array}{|c|c|}\hline \text{Activity} & \text{Immediate prerequisite(s)} \\ \hline E & B \\ \hline F & C, D \\ \hline G & C, D \\ \hline \end{array}$$

$$\therefore\ E: B;\quad F: C, D;\quad G: C, D$$

solutions.latex:
List every path from Start to Finish and add the times.

$$\begin{aligned} A, C, F, H &: 4+3+3+2 = 12\\ A, C, G &: 4+3+4 = 11\\ B, D, F, H &: 2+6+3+2 = 13\\ B, D, G &: 2+6+4 = 12\\ B, E &: 2+5 = 7 \end{aligned}$$
The critical path is the longest path.

$$\therefore\ \text{the critical path is } B, D, F, H \text{ and the minimum completion time is } 13 \text{ hours}$$
criteria: Finds the lengths of the paths, or states the critical path or the time, or equivalent merit

solutions.latex:
Find the earliest start time at the node where $C$ and $D$ end:
$$\begin{aligned} \text{via } A, C &: 4+3 = 7 \\ \text{via } B, D &: 2+6 = 8 \end{aligned}$$
The earliest time at that node is the larger, $8$ hours. So $X$ starts at this node, where $F$ and $G$ also start.

The latest start of $X$ is $9$ and its time is $2$, so it must be finished by $11$. The latest start time of $H$ is $13-2=11$, so the node where $F$ ends and $H$ starts has latest time $11$. So $X$ ends at that node.

The new edge $X(2)$ runs from the node where $C$ and $D$ end to the node where $F$ ends and $H$ begins.

\exfigure{825_q37_s1}

$$\therefore\ X(2) \text{ is drawn from the end of } C \text{ and } D \text{ to the start of } H$$

$$\text{Critical path: } D \to F \to H$$
Minimum completion time: $14$ hours.

solutions.latex:
Float time is the minimum completion time less the activity's duration and the earliest start time.
$$\begin{aligned} \text{Float time} &= 14 - 4 - 7 \\ &= 3 \text{ hours} \end{aligned}$$

The latest starting time of $A$ is after 2 hours.
$$\therefore\ \text{LST}(A) = 2 \text{ hours}$$

parts.latex:
A project involves five activities, A to E.

\extable{3300_qD11_t1}

The minimum time for the project to be completed is 17 weeks.

How long does activity C take to complete?

solutions.latex:
The network has A $(6)$, B $(3)$, a dummy from B to the end of A, C, D $(2)$ and E $(3)$.

The project ends at $17$, so the earliest time at the start of E is $17-3=14$.

$$6+C=14$$

So $C=8$ weeks.

\exfigure{3300_qD11_s1}

Hence the answer is A.
